22:# ── Require root (losetup, mount, mkfs need elevated privileges) ──────────────
45:IMG_SIZE_MB=3072       # 3 GiB total image (for 4 GiB card minimum)
57:log "Allocating ${IMG_SIZE_MB} MiB image: ${OUTPUT}"
58:dd if=/dev/zero of="${OUTPUT}" bs=1M count="${IMG_SIZE_MB}" status=progress
70:LOOP=$(losetup --find --show --partscan "${OUTPUT}")
71:log "Loop device: ${LOOP}"
76:    losetup -d "${LOOP}" 2>/dev/null || true
80:BOOT_DEV="${LOOP}p1"
81:ROOT_DEV="${LOOP}p2"
82:DATA_DEV="${LOOP}p3"
